manifesto.title: Why Cerneo?
manifesto.paragraph1: Cerneo comes from the fusion of Cerne — the core, the essence — and Neo — the new, the evolution. Technology built from a solid foundation.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Cerneo was born from a simple question: why are so many business tools so hard to use?
story.paragraph2: Founded by software engineers, the company exists to build products that work as they should — reliable, intuitive, and ready for the real world. We bring together solutions that share the same foundation: tested code, user-centered design, and solid infrastructure.
story.paragraph3: Our name combines Cerne (essence) and Neo (new). We build the new from foundations that work.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Cerneo Tecnologia Ltda. ("Cerneo", "we") values the privacy of our users. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

collection.title: 2. Data Collected
collection.content: We may collect the following personal data:
items: Identification data: name, email, phone, tax ID
Usage data: pages visited, browsing time, IP address
Device data: browser type, operating system, screen resolution
Voluntarily provided data: contact messages, feedback

usage.title: 3. Use of Data
items: Provide and improve our services and products
Communicate updates, news, and relevant information
Ensure the security and integrity of our systems
Comply with legal and regulatory obligations
Statistical analysis and user experience improvement

sharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We may share data with: essential service providers (hosting, analytics), legal authorities when required by law, and Cerneo group companies for operational purposes.

storage.title: 5. Storage and Security
storage.content: Your data is stored on secure servers with encryption in transit and at rest. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
items: Confirm the existence of data processing
Access your personal data
Correct incomplete or outdated data
Request anonymization, blocking, or deletion of data
Request data portability
Revoke consent at any time

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.content: To exercise your rights or clarify questions about this policy, contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at: privacy@cerneo.com.br

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Cerneo Tecnologia Ltda. ("Cerneo") services, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, do not use our services.

services.title: 2. Description of Services
services.content: Cerneo is a technology holding that offers software products, including Cerneo Kalender. Each product may have additional specific terms.

responsibilities.title: 3. User Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: By using our services, you agree to:
items: Provide truthful and up-to-date information
Maintain the confidentiality of your access credentials
Not use the services for illegal or unauthorized purposes
Not attempt to access restricted areas of our systems
Respect Cerneo's and third parties' intellectual property

ip.title: 4. Intellectual Property
ip.content: All content, source code, design, trademarks, logos, and materials available in Cerneo's services are the exclusive property of Cerneo or its licensors. No intellectual property rights are transferred to the user by using the services.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Cerneo strives to keep its services available and functional but does not guarantee uninterrupted availability. We are not responsible for: indirect damages, lost profits, data loss caused by factors beyond our control, or temporary service unavailability.

modifications.title: 6. Modifications
modifications.content: Cerneo reserves the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time. Significant changes will be communicated by email or through notice in our services. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

governing.title: 7. Governing Law
governing.content: These Terms of Use are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. Any dispute shall be submitted to the courts of São Paulo, SP, to the exclusion of any other.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.content: For questions about these Terms of Use, contact us at: legal@cerneo.com.br

commitment.title: 1. Our Commitment
commitment.content: Cerneo Tecnologia Ltda. ("Cerneo") conducts its business with integrity and respect for people. This Code of Conduct and Ethics applies to all partners, employees, contractors, suppliers and business partners of Cerneo. Our practices are aligned with the International Bill of Human Rights, the International Labour Organization (ILO) Declaration on Fundamental Principles and Rights at Work, the Ten Principles of the United Nations Global Compact and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

humanRights.title: 2. Human Rights
humanRights.content: We respect and support the protection of internationally recognized human rights across all our operations and business relationships. We seek to identify, prevent and mitigate any adverse human rights impacts that may be linked to our activities, products or partnerships.

labor.title: 3. Labor Practices and Freedom of Association
labor.content: We fully comply with Brazilian employment law and observe international labour standards. This includes:
items: Formal employment and fair compensation in accordance with applicable law
Respect for working hours and rest periods
Freedom of association and effective recognition of the right to collective bargaining
A dignified work environment, with respect and fair treatment for everyone

slavery.title: 4. Forced Labor, Modern Slavery and Child Labor
slavery.content: We have zero tolerance for any form of forced or compulsory labor, modern slavery, human trafficking and child labor. We do not employ minors in violation of applicable law, and we require the same commitment from all our suppliers and business partners.

discrimination.title: 5. Non-Discrimination and Equal Opportunity
discrimination.content: All decisions on hiring, compensation, promotion and termination are based solely on merit, competence and business need. We do not tolerate discrimination based on:
items: Race, color, ethnicity or nationality
Gender, gender identity or sexual orientation
Age, marital or family status
Religion, belief or political opinion
Disability or health condition
Union membership

harassment.title: 6. A Workplace Free from Violence and Harassment
harassment.content: We ensure a work environment free from physical violence, threats, corporal punishment, mental coercion, verbal abuse, disrespectful behaviour, bullying and harassment of any kind, including moral and sexual harassment. Any such conduct results in disciplinary measures, up to termination and referral to the authorities where applicable.

health.title: 7. Health and Safety
health.content: We provide a safe and healthy work environment. As a remote-first company, this includes guidance on ergonomics, respect for working-time limits, encouragement of work-life balance and attention to the team's mental health. We comply with the occupational health and safety regulations applicable to our activities.

minerals.title: 8. Responsible Mineral Sourcing
minerals.content: As a software company, Cerneo does not directly source or process minerals in its value chain. Nevertheless, we expect equipment and hardware suppliers to adopt responsible, conflict-free mineral sourcing practices in line with OECD guidance.

suppliers.title: 9. Suppliers and Partners
suppliers.content: We expect our suppliers and business partners to share the commitments in this Code, including respect for human rights, employment laws, business integrity and data protection. Violation of these principles may result in termination of the business relationship.

reporting.title: 10. Violations and Reporting
reporting.content: Anyone may report actual or suspected violations of this Code through our Whistleblowing Channel at etica@cerneo.com.br. We guarantee confidentiality, the option of anonymity and protection from retaliation, as described in our Whistleblowing Channel policy.

commitment.title: 1. Commitment
commitment.content: Cerneo Tecnologia Ltda. has zero tolerance for corruption and bribery in all their forms. We comply with the Brazilian Anti-Corruption Law (Law No. 12,846/2013), the Criminal Code and other applicable rules, as well as the principles of international anti-corruption legislation. This policy applies to all partners, employees, contractors and third parties acting on behalf of Cerneo.

prohibited.title: 2. Prohibited Conduct
prohibited.content: The following are expressly prohibited, among others:
items: Offering, promising, paying or authorizing bribes or kickbacks to public or private agents
Requesting or accepting improper advantages, directly or indirectly
Facilitation payments to speed up administrative acts
Fraud, falsification of documents or accounting records
Money laundering or financing of illicit activities

gifts.title: 3. Gifts and Hospitality
gifts.content: Gifts and hospitality are acceptable only when of symbolic value, non-recurring and without intent to influence business decisions. Offering or receiving anything of value to obtain an improper advantage is prohibited.

thirdParties.title: 4. Third Parties and Due Diligence
thirdParties.content: We assess the integrity of suppliers and partners before and during the business relationship. Contracts include anti-corruption clauses whenever applicable. Third parties acting on behalf of Cerneo must fully observe this policy.

records.title: 5. Books and Records
records.content: We keep accurate and complete books and records that faithfully reflect all transactions. No record may be falsified, omitted or distorted to conceal improper payments or purposes.

reporting.title: 6. Reporting and Consequences
reporting.content: Suspected violations of this policy must be reported through the Whistleblowing Channel (etica@cerneo.com.br), with guaranteed confidentiality and non-retaliation. Violations subject those involved to disciplinary measures, contract termination and referral to the competent authorities.

purpose.title: 1. Purpose
purpose.content: Cerneo's Whistleblowing Channel is the official means for employees, suppliers, partners, customers and any third party to report, in good faith, actual or suspected violations of our policies, our Code of Conduct and Ethics or the law.

scope.title: 2. What Can Be Reported
scope.content: Examples of matters that can be reported:
items: Harassment, bullying, violence or disrespectful behaviour
Discrimination of any kind
Corruption, bribery, fraud or conflicts of interest
Labor or human rights violations
Forced labor, modern slavery or child labor
Privacy and data protection violations

how.title: 3. How to Report
how.content: Reports can be sent to etica@cerneo.com.br. Identification is not required: anonymous reports are accepted and treated with the same seriousness. The more detail provided (facts, dates, people involved, evidence), the more effective the investigation.

confidentiality.title: 4. Confidentiality
confidentiality.content: All reports are handled with strict confidentiality. The reporter's identity, when provided, is known only to the people directly responsible for the investigation and is never disclosed to those involved in the report.

nonRetaliation.title: 5. Protection from Retaliation
nonRetaliation.content: Cerneo expressly prohibits any form of retaliation — such as dismissal, demotion, persecution or hostile treatment — against anyone who, in good faith, submits a report or cooperates with an investigation. Acts of retaliation are themselves serious violations subject to disciplinary measures.

handling.title: 6. Handling of Reports
handling.content: Every report is recorded, analyzed and investigated impartially and within a reasonable time. When substantiated, it results in proportionate corrective and disciplinary measures, which may include termination, contract rescission and referral to the authorities. Identified reporters receive feedback on the conclusion of the case, within the limits of confidentiality.
